Evaluating $F(x)$ at $x=4,$ we get the following definite integral:

$$
F(4)={\int }_{0}^{4}{t}^{2}\,\text{d}t
$$

Now, computing the definite integral, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(4) & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{t}^{2}\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\frac{{t}^{3}}{3}|}_{0}^{4} \\  & =\frac{{4}^{3}}{3}-\frac{{0}^{3}}{3} \\  & =\frac{64}{3}-0 \\  & =\frac{64}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
